results.summary_before: This design is a multicycle CPU that executes programs written in the BF (Brainfuck) language. It has no on-chip RAM; both program and data tape reside in an external SPI RAM emulated by an RP2040 running spi-ram-emu. The CPU uses an on-chip SPI master to access memory, performing at least one SPI transaction per instruction. It is tested with cocotb and requires an external RP2040 for memory, making it suitable for educational purposes.
results.summary: TeenyTPU is a 2x2 INT8 systolic array TPU designed for matrix multiplication operations. It features a 2x2 grid of Processing Elements that perform matrix multiplication on INT8 data, producing 16-bit partial sums. The design includes an SPI slave bridge for communication with an external host, supporting opcodes for loading weights, activations, and reading results. It requires an external SPI master connected to the designated pins for testing and operation.
